experiment.intervention: Only native initial QSNOW; float64(source)*float64(alpha), cast to native float32. All other variables and metadata unchanged from each family baseline.

evaluation.strong_precipitation_definition: Hourly precipitation >=10 mm, the study threshold.

selection.eligible_cases: 38 completed CONTROL/IMPROVED candidates: 30 prior eligible cases already scored plus these eight if completed and identity validated; CURRENT_HYDRO is contextual only.
selection.prior_known_selection: Prior 30 eligible candidate scores and the previous single-case selection are known before these eight runs; report this extension as diagnostic same-event selection and preserve that known-selection context.
selection.undefined_scores: Undefined CSI ranks below defined CSI; undefined FAR after defined FAR. Do not replace undefined metrics with zero.
outputs: all eligible cases by lead and threshold with contingency counts and continuous errors
selection.incomplete_or_failed_cases: Exclude from completed six-hour selection; preserve failure evidence.

limitations: Same-event selection; no independent skill validation.
QSNOW-only changes initial water without compensating other species or energy; diagnostic, not conservative or operational.
Score total surface precipitation, not snowfall alone.
No averaging across thresholds, leads, or experiments.
CONTROL and IMPROVED comparisons differ in initialization and executable; alpha effects are isolated only within a family.
